description: Hung in Terminal 3 and dedicated there in 2007; the City of Phoenix describes it as about 80 percent original parts drawn from three SPAD airframes with the remainder reproduced; refurbished and assembled by GossHawk Unlimited; no identity has been published; Terminal 3 was rebuilt between 2019 and 2022 and no photograph of the aircraft in place after January 2012 has been found so its survival of that rebuild is unconfirmed
